# Scott Augenbaum | CyberSecure Mindset

> Scott Augenbaum is a retired FBI Supervisory Special Agent (Cyber Division), author and keynote speaker based in the Nashville, Tennessee area. He spent 30 years with the FBI, interviewed more than 1,000 cybercrime victims, and created the CyberSecure Mindset: Emotion + Access = Loss, and Pause, Verify, Protect Access. His mission is 1,000,000 people protected from cybercriminals by 2030.

## Book Scott
- Direct booking, no agency fee: scottaugenbaum@cybersecuremindset.com
- Contact form: https://cybersecuremindset.com/contact
- Keynotes and workshops: https://cybersecuremindset.com/speaking
- Executive and board advisory: https://cybersecuremindset.com/advisory
- Security awareness training and online courses: https://cybersecuremindset.com/courses
- Keynotes from $10,000 in person and $7,500 virtual

## Core ideas
- The Four Truths of cybercrime: nobody expects to be a victim; lost money is rarely recovered; the criminals are rarely arrested; most cybercrime can be prevented
- Emotion + Access = Loss
- Pause. Verify. Protect Access.

## Books
- The Secret to Cybersecurity (2019), Scott E. Augenbaum
- The CyberSecure Mindset (upcoming)
